source.note: Projected directly from the OpenAPI document in VMware's Apache-2.0 vcf-api-specs repository. It is not transcribed from a documentation page, and it is not the 9.1 revision of the same file.
source.projectionRule: Project only the two operations the client calls, plus the schema members needed to acquire a token and page a full alert collection. The alert schema is trimmed to the members the fixtures carry; every other projected schema is reproduced whole. xml and example keys are dropped and $ref targets are rewritten from #/components/schemas/ to #/schemas/.

operations.summary: Acquire a token to perform REST API calls

200.description: The token and expiry time of the token

operations.summary: Look up Alerts by their identifiers or using the identifiers of the Resources they are associated with

parameters.name: resourceId
parameters.description: Identifiers of the Resources whose Alerts you need to be looked up

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number from which data needs to be displayed (0-based)

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Expected number of entries per page

200.description: Alerts matching the specified identifiers. Can be empty

500.description: Error occurred while retrieving the Alert with the specified identifier

username-password.description: Represents model of Username and Password

token.description: Auth token for accessing future rest API(s)

validity.description: Token expiration time in milliseconds (since Jan 1, 1970)

expiresAt.description: Token expiration time, in easy to read string representation (since Jan 1, 1970)

roles.description: List of roles the current user has

items.description: List of roles the current user has

auth-token.description:
Authentication token returned by
VMware Cloud Foundation Operations for future REST API calls.

resourceId.description: The UUID of the Resource causing the Alert

type.description: The Alert Type describing the Alert

status.description:
Indicates the current condition of an Alert.
Used to determine if the conditions for the Alert still continue to exist.

startTimeUTC.description: The UTC time when the Alert started

cancelTimeUTC.description: The UTC time when the Alert was cancelled

updateTimeUTC.description: The UTC time when the Alert was updated

controlState.description: The control state of an Alert

alertDefinitionName.description: Localized name of the associated Alert Definition

pageSize.description: Number of entries allowed in a page

sortBy.description: A CSV list of field names. Usually found in an enumeration, e.g. ResourceField

sortOrder.description: A CSV list of SortOrder values. If not specified or if list is shorter than sortFields then SortOrder.ASCENDING is assumed.

page-info.description: Represents page information for a paged result

href.description:
The url part of this tag. Note that the href can be absolute or relative to the current url.
If the href begins with '/', then its absolute.
If the href begins with the protocol element(http, https), its absolute
Otherwise its relative.

rel.description: Represents the link's relation to its parent tag/object

link.description:
Represents a HTTP 'link' element.
It is implicit that all the link tags support http 'GET' method.
